parsed.name: policy_geopolitics_rearmament_minerals
parsed.strategy: Bet on policy-driven rearmament and critical-minerals nationalism: European defense primes with confirmed Q3 prints inside the window (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, Saab, Kongsberg, Leonardo, Hanwha, MHI), uranium/nuclear fuel security (Cameco, Centrus), US government equity stakes (Intel, MP Materials, Trilogy), and semiconductor policy beneficiaries (ASML, TSMC, Hon Hai). Pharma PDUFAs (Vertex, Merck, Cogent, BridgeBio) and gambling (Evolution, Aristocrat) diversify away from pure defense beta. Wrong if a de-escalation headline (Ukraine ceasefire, US-China detente) compresses the geopolitical risk premium across the book simultaneously, or if multiple PDUFAs return CRLs.
parsed.objective: Relative P&L vs Bloomberg WLS index, 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13, long-only global policy/geopolitics book
